stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Emdoor is introducing on-device AI tools designed for automotive repair workshops. The company aims to integrate these technologies into existing service workflows to assist with maintenance and diagnostic tasks.

stories.title: JSW Motors partners with AWS
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. JSW Motors has entered a partnership with AWS to host connected-car data on servers located in India. The collaboration is intended to support the company's data infrastructure ahead of its first vehicle launch.

stories.title: Central computing architecture market trends
stories.summary: The market for central computing architecture and vehicle operating systems is entering a phase of platform consolidation. Automakers are transitioning from distributed electronic control units to centralized architectures, with the market expected to evolve significantly through 2035.

stories.title: Predictive AI in automotive logistics
stories.summary: Automakers are increasingly adopting AI to move logistics beyond shipment tracking toward predictive decision-making. Representatives from BMW and GM noted that these digital tools are being used to anticipate supply chain disruptions and optimize transport routes in Mexico.

stories.title: Nvidia leadership change
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has stepped down as CEO of Nvidia after 33 years. CFO Colette Kress has been appointed interim CEO while the company searches for a successor. The transition occurs as Nvidia deepens its collaborations with major car manufacturers on autonomous driving technology.

stories.title: JSW Motors localizes connected-car data
stories.summary: JSW Motors has partnered with AWS to host connected-car platform data on servers within India. The company states that all driving and location information will remain under its own control. Other telematics components are being localized through partnerships with firms like Tata Elxsi.

stories.title: Google updates its robot brain
stories.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model designed to improve dexterity and safety. The company reports success rates for tasks increased by up to 100 percent, with execution speeds rising by 30 percent. Automotive manufacturing is serving as the primary testing ground for the model.

stories.title: Automotive software shifts toward centralized compute
stories.summary: Automakers are moving away from distributed electronic control units toward centralized platforms to handle advanced driver assistance and infotainment systems. Consolidating these workloads onto a single system on a chip aims to reduce costs and complexity. The approach introduces new challenges in managing mixed criticality and software functions.

stories.title: Technology proposed to address road safety
stories.summary: Road safety expert K K Kapila suggests that emerging technologies, including vehicle-to-vehicle communication and AI-based accident prediction, could improve India's road safety system. The proposals also include using bike ambulances to navigate narrow roads. The expert notes that technology must focus on protecting human lives alongside vehicle improvements.

stories.title: Proposed federal fee for electric vehicles
stories.summary: The BUILD America 250 Act could impose an annual registration fee on electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles as soon as December. The legislation aims to offset declining gas tax revenue. If passed, the fee would start at 130 dollars for EVs and 35 dollars for plug-in hybrids.

stories.title: Canadian automotive sector influence questioned
stories.summary: A commentary piece reflects on the economic disruption caused by industrial job losses in Thunder Bay during the 1980s and 1990s. The author questions the political focus on the automotive sector following the sale of a Stellantis assembly plant to an armoured-vehicle manufacturer.

stories.title: Ottawa considers luxury tax threshold for electric vehicles
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Access to the report regarding the Canadian luxury tax threshold for electric vehicles is currently restricted. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Fleet professionals request van adoption support
stories.summary: The Association of Fleet Professionals supports maintaining the 2030 target for electric car sales but recommends lowering the goal for electric vans from 70 percent to 40 percent. The group argues that fleets require more assistance to manage the transition and maintain investment levels.

stories.title: Indian government mandates electric vehicles for official use
stories.summary: The Ministry of Finance has made electric vehicles the default choice for official government cars, setting a price ceiling of 20 lakh rupees. The move is intended to accelerate EV adoption across government fleets and reduce reliance on conventional fuels. The policy update was issued on 10 November.

stories.title: Stand-Up India scheme extended to 2031
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the continuation of the Stand-Up India scheme for five years, targeting 2.5 lakh new entrepreneurs from women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe communities. The scheme provides financial assistance for greenfield enterprises. It has facilitated loans to 2.75 lakh entrepreneurs since 2016.

stories.title: NASCAR legend Jack Roush holds estate sale
stories.summary: NASCAR figure Jack Roush is selling furnishings, collectibles, and mementos from his Northville home this weekend. The 84-year-old previously auctioned dozens of cars from his museum collection in September. The current sale includes items from his personal residence.

stories.title: Kenny Wallace criticizes NASCAR marketing
stories.summary: NASCAR commentator Kenny Wallace claims the sport failed to promote Justin Allgaier before his 2026 championship win. Wallace argued that the sanctioning body's marketing strategy overlooked the veteran driver. He credited Allgaier and the Earnhardt family for their influence on the sport's recent success.

stories.title: Arvid Lindblad discusses F1 season
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Access to the interview regarding Arvid Lindblad's cultural background and his 2026 Formula 1 season overview is currently restricted. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Canton Auto Body implements eco-friendly protocols
stories.summary: Canton Auto Body Inc. has introduced new repair procedures to minimize environmental impact. The facility is shifting away from solvent-based paints that release volatile organic compounds. The updated protocols focus on waste management and material usage during vehicle restoration and refinishing tasks.

stories.title: Hypergraph network optimizes solar EV charging
stories.summary: Researchers have developed a hypergraph-based control algorithm to optimize power flow at hybrid electric vehicle charging stations. A simulation study confirmed that the strategy improves energy management and charging efficiency when integrating solar power with the utility grid. The system was tested across multiple operating conditions.

stories.title: Study tracks automotive component reuse
stories.summary: Engineering researchers have formulated a cradle-to-reuse-to-grave assessment model to track automotive components across multiple life cycles. The study suggests that reuse pathways significantly alter cumulative carbon footprints compared to single-life configurations. The model addresses a blind spot in early vehicle design and material selection.

stories.title: India expands critical minerals search
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Access to the report on private companies joining state-run firms in the search for overseas critical minerals is currently restricted. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Electric vehicle battery lifespans exceed expectations
stories.summary: Used car dealers and telematics companies report that electric vehicle batteries are lasting longer than the standard eight-year or 100,000-mile warranty periods. Batteries that drop below 80 percent capacity are being repurposed for energy storage. The chemistry behind these extended lifespans is currently being studied.

stories.title: Automotive executives face continuous change
stories.summary: More than 775 automotive executives report that digital technology, AI, shifting customer expectations and geopolitical tensions are converging into a single leadership challenge. The industry is moving away from discrete trends toward a requirement to manage continuous change across multiple fronts simultaneously. The boardroom is currently very busy.

stories.title: Australia EV lobby access restricted
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Access to the report on Australia's electric vehicle lobby is currently restricted to readers who can bypass crawler bot detection software. The website requires JavaScript and the removal of ad blockers to view the content.

stories.title: JLR returns to operating profit
stories.summary: Jaguar Land Rover recorded quarterly revenue of £5.9 billion, a 20.3% increase compared to the same period last year. Profit before tax and exceptional items reached £6 million for the quarter. The company is now pinning its future growth on a new electric vehicle push.

stories.title: Xpeng targets UK premium market
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Xpeng is planning to enter the UK market with five new models as part of a strategy to lead the premium electric vehicle segment. The company is currently working to establish its footprint in the region.

stories.title: Tesla sales drop in China
stories.summary: Tesla sold 8,817 vehicles in China during October, falling out of the top 10 new energy vehicle brands. BYD maintained its lead in the market, while Xiaomi Auto sales rose 25.3% from the previous month. Rankings in the world's largest car market are proving volatile.

stories.title: BMW opens South Carolina battery plant
stories.summary: BMW has officially opened its Woodruff battery plant in South Carolina. The facility will employ 250 robots to assemble battery packs for the company's new electric vehicles. The plant is located 15 miles from the existing vehicle production site in Greer. The robots are now reporting for duty.

stories.title: Poland attracts automotive investment
stories.summary: Representatives from 40 companies met to discuss the future of the Polish automotive industry, focusing on AI, robotics and cybersecurity. Siemens Poland noted that competitiveness is no longer determined by costs alone, but by the speed of response to supply chain disruptions. Modernization is the current priority.

stories.title: JLR cuts profit outlook
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Jaguar Land Rover has reportedly reduced its profit outlook due to weakening demand in the Chinese market. The company is facing challenges as it attempts to navigate shifting global economic conditions.

stories.title: JLR confirms electric Defender Sport
stories.summary: JLR CEO PB Balaji confirmed that production of the new electric Defender Sport will begin next year at the Halewood plant. The model will share the flexible EMA platform with the upcoming Range Rover GT. The company is currently offering both electric and hybrid powertrain options.

stories.title: Aion i60 launches in Indonesia
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Aion has debuted its i60 model in Indonesia following 100,000 sales in China. The company is expanding its international presence as it seeks to replicate its domestic success in new markets.

stories.title: BYD holds Abu Dhabi parade
stories.summary: BYD staged a parade of 110 vehicles in Abu Dhabi to celebrate a new production-car speed record set by its electric hypercar. The convoy featured models from the BYD, DENZA and YANGWANG brands. The YANGWANG U9 Xtreme recently recorded a top speed of 503.17km/h.

research.title: APG-Planner: Learning Vision-Based High-Speed Trajectory Planning via Analytic Policy Gradient
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-based high-speed navigation requires a trajectory planner that can reactively generate smooth, collision-free trajectories from onboard visual observations. Deep reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to vision-based trajectory planning, as it enables the optimization of sequential. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: ARTS: An Open-Source, Reproducible Three-Arm Platform for Autonomy Research in Minimally Invasive Surgery
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Research on surgical autonomy needs open platforms that any laboratory can build, yet the most widely shared platform depends on donated clinical hardware, and open alternatives on industrial arms each lack part of the surgical chain. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Are We Ready for Snow-tonomous Driving? Challenges Toward Robust Automated Driving in Extreme Weather
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated driving has gained remarkable momentum over the past decade, with both industry and academia investing substantial resources in developing perception and control solutions to advance vehicle autonomy. However, these efforts have largely focused on clear-weather. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Autonomous Trail Racing with a Bicycle Robot
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Navigating off-road trails on a mountain bike requires diverse locomotion skills, including aerial maneuvers, cornering, and slip recovery, paired with sophisticated perception for scene understanding. Translating these capabilities to autonomous, two-wheeled robots remains a formidable challenge. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Can I join you? Extended Social Force Based Model with Predictive Control and Barrier Functions for Humanoid Group Repositioning Amidst Obst
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: As social and service robots increasingly share interaction spaces in public, they may form groups while coordinating tasks or interacting with humans. Initial group formation alone is insufficient in dynamic settings, because it can be disrupted. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: DIVAL: Diffeomorphic Vector-Field Alignment for Nonholonomic Motion Planning
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional vector-field-based motion planners for nonholonomic robots consist of two steps: first designing a nominal vector field and then controlling the robot to follow it to approach the target. However, a nonholonomic robot cannot follow the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
